text:
nina: quick sync — proposing a precision-profile "packaging" invariant: every model bundle must include an explicit per-shard precision map, preferred kernel list, and a signed checksum. this is to prevent node/kernel mismatches at serve time.

owen: +1. will older runtimes choke on the extra blob?

jen: plan is additive. header keeps current fields; add optional profile_blob (cbor) and profile_json. runtime prefers the blob but falls back to json. older runtimes ignore unknown keys.

sylvia: ops concern: if a node advertises a kernel but its layout differs (sparse vs dense), we get huge perf regressions. need an explicit layout tag in the profile and a linter that blocks deployment if packager and node-registry disagree.

nina: linter rules I'm thinking: profile has profile_version, per_shard_layout strings, preferred_kernels; lint checks kernel registry, checkssum matches packaged kernels, ensures fallback_order present. block deploy on failures with actionable error messages.

owen: tests: add a sampling harness that records the exact token stream when a fallback happens and ties it to quant.path telemetry. that helps replay and QA validation.

sylvia: rollout: canary pool advertises mixed-bit support via node metadata. routing layer must match request.profile_id to pool capabilities. example rule: when request.headers.precision_profile == "mixed-v1" route to pool:mixed_canary else pool:stable.

jen: fallback enforcement: runtime consults profile.fallback_order and profile.quality_budget_pct. before applying a fallback it checks estimated_quality_delta from a compact calibration table in the profile; if delta exceeds budget, reject fallback and route to dense variant or return 503 with quant.quality_status=blocked.

sylvia: ops automation: smoke job should run lint -> deploy kernel -> run perf smoke -> run fidelity delta on curated prompts -> flip routing tag. I'll add metrics for profile_mismatch_execute_failures and quant.quality_delta.

own: docs/devex: add SDK opt-in flag allow_mixed_profile and a console accept dialog for allow_aggressive_fallbacks. also provide a CLI to infer a profile: redwood-quant pack --infer-profile.

ops-bot: Lint job queued for deployment mixed-profile-canary. status: queued.

jen: I'll draft the profile schema and PR. aim to land lint + sampling harness before the canary next week. thanks all.
